description: The file is a Java unit test class for `FeaturePropertiesModified`, including multiple test methods verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation behaviors.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing behaviors and properties of `FeaturePropertiesModified` class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the `FeaturePropertiesModified` class is immutable and that `FeatureProperties` is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the `hashCode` and `equals` methods of `FeaturePropertiesModified` are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null string ThingId throws `ThingIdInvalidException`.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null `ThingId` object throws `NullPointerException`.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null feature ID throws `NullPointerException`.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullProperties
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null properties throws `NullPointerException`.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the `toJson` method on `FeaturePropertiesModified` returns the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a `FeaturePropertiesModified` object can be correctly created from JSON input.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeatureProperties
methods.description: Tests behavior when JSON with null feature properties is parsed into `FeaturePropertiesModified`.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the resource path generated by `getResourcePath()` is as expected.
